questions.question: Supply the co-authors and publication details of Electricity in Living Organisms so the edition is unambiguous. Mathematics with a Human Face is retained as an essay, not invented as a separate monograph; the publisher’s Gelfand memorial volume includes Glagoleva’s text under that title.

questions.resolution: The Math.ru scan confirms M. B. Berkinblit and E. G. Glagoleva, Electricity in Living Organisms (Moscow: Nauka, 1988), Kvant Library no. 69.
